name: io.github.kevincolahan/high-water-index
title: High Water Index
description: Flood and homeowners insurance data by county and town, from FEMA, Senate and Treasury records.

tools.name: estimate_flood_premium
tools.description: Typical federal (NFIP) flood premium for homes like the one described, from policy-level data for covered coastal counties. Returns p25/p50/p75, policy count, and an 18%-cap projection. Not a quote.

tools.name: town_trend
tools.description: Median flood premium by year and policies in force for a covered county or town, plus county non-renewal rates.

tools.name: insurance_context
tools.description: National coverage: homeowners premium, non-renewal rate and loss ratio by year for a ZIP (2018-2022), and/or county non-renewal rate by year (2018-2023).

tools.name: parcel_report
tools.description: Look up a Cape May County parcel by address. Returns tax assessment, FEMA flood zone, and — when an elevation certificate is on file — diagram number, lowest-floor elevation, BFE, freeboard in feet, certificate date, surveyor source, plus the town's published premium band for that freeboard with policy count and median annual cost, and the coverage line. No dollar estimate for the parcel itself.

address.description: Street address (e.g. '204 Sounds Avenue, Sea Isle City, NJ')

tools.name: request_quotes
tools.description: Send a person's details to up to 3 licensed insurance agencies that write the ZIP, so they can contact the person about flood/homeowners coverage. Before calling, show the person this exact consent text and get an explicit yes: "I agree that High Water Index may share the details I entered with up to three licensed insurance agencies that serve my ZIP code, and with its own team, so they can contact me by email and by phone about this request. Calls will be placed by a person; this consent does not cover autodialed calls, prerecorded messages, or marketing text messages. High Water Index is a data publisher, not an insurance agency: it does not sell, solicit or recommend policies, and agencies pay it a flat fee per request that is not tied to any sale. Agreeing is not a condition of buying anything. I can withdraw this consent at any time by emailing leads@highwaterindex.com." Then pass consent=true and consent_version="2026-10-21". High Water Index is a data publisher, not an agency, and is paid a flat fee per request not tied to any sale. Terms: https://highwaterindex.com/terms/#agents

consent.description: true only after the person agreed to the consent text in this tool's description

consent_version.description: the consent version shown to the person; current is 2026-10-21

found_us.description: which assistant or app the person is using
